findings.fact: $50 minimum, $1000 per day per ERC20 address for Classic and Pay From Profits; multiple accounts sharing address share cap. Payouts USDC ERC20, trader pays gas.
findings.consequence: Large profits may require multiple days to withdraw; wallet network costs apply.

findings.fact: $2000 daily payout cap per ERC20 address; payout only when smart-contract eligibility satisfied.
findings.consequence: Do not advertise unrestricted instant payouts.

findings.fact: Section 9.1.2 permits suspension, freezing of payments and wallet assets without prior notice or stated reason in specified risk, legal, unusual-activity and security circumstances; language also says for any reason at any time.
findings.consequence: Broad suspension and payout-freeze authority requires legal remedy/appeal examination.

findings.fact: Funded fee must be fully covered from eligible A-book profit split before profit is withdrawable. Higher risk-group classification can require additional fee settlement.
findings.consequence: Challenge purchase price alone does not reflect cost before first payout.

findings.fact: When A-book drawdown reaches specified threshold, open positions are forcibly closed and account switches to B-book. B-book gains are not cash withdrawable and are removed on A-book reactivation; subsequent A-book gains first offset negative A-book P&L.
findings.consequence: Displayed trading gains may not correspond to withdrawable profits; risk threshold needs exact annex verification.

findings.fact: Transparency page shows transaction hashes alongside account type, nominal balance and fee; table entries do not by themselves establish independent verified trader reward transfers. Verify hash on explorer and beneficiary context.
findings.consequence: Do not award high A3 solely for operator-provided transaction table.

findings.fact: FAQ names TradingHive Technologies Ltd as representing FundedHive DAC; exact contract counterparty and corporate registry independently unverified.
